  Exam Date & Time: 18-Nov-2025 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  THIRD SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER 2023  
  Object Oriented Programming [ECM_2124]  
  Marks: 50                                                                  Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           Differentiate between thread and process with proper diagram.  
  (2)  
  A)  
  B)            Write a Java program to display the HCF (GCD) of two given numbers.                        (3)  
  C)            Create a class Triangle with sides as private fields. Create a subclass RightTriangle with  
  an additional field for height. Similarly, create a class Square and a subclass Cube with  
  appropriate data members. Define an interface with area() and volume() methods, and        (5)  
  implement them in all classes. In main(), print area and volume of each shape.  
  
  2)                 What is inheritance? Explain types of inheritance supported in Java.  
  (2)  
  A)  
  B)            Explain the use of this keyword in Java with an example.                                   (3)  
  C)            Write a Java program to: i) Accept a sentence from the user. ii) Create two threads-one  
  to count the number of words, another to find the longest word. iii) After both threads    (5)  
  finish, display "TASK COMPLETED".  
  
  3)                 Distinguish between compile-time and runtime polymorphism.  
  (2)  
  A)  
  B)            Explain how interfaces help achieve loose coupling in Java.                                (3)  
  C)            Create a base class Shape with a display() method. Derive classes Circle and Rectangle.  
  When display() is called using different objects, it should print respective area details. (5)  
  Do not use constructors.  
  
  4)                 Write two differences between start() and run() methods of a Thread.  
  (2)  
  A)  
  B)            Write a Java program demonstrating use of multiple catch blocks for handling different  
  exceptions.                                                                                (3)  
  
  C)            Write a Java program where the main thread creates three child threads to calculate the    (5)  
  sum of each row in a 3×3 matrix. The main thread displays the total sum of the matrix  
  using results from child threads and also prints its priority. (Use Runnable interface.)

  type parameters.  
  (2)

  B)             Demonstrate the use of an upper-bounded wildcard (< ? extends T>) with a Java  
  Collection.                                                                                (3)  
  
  C)             Create a generic class Pair< T, U> with methods to set and get two values of different  
  types. Write a test program showing pairs of (Integer, String) and (String, Double).       (5)
